best_section.where: the sealed car park serving Oxley United Football Club and the tennis courts, just past the gravel loop at the pin

summary: Sports-club car park ringed by oval and trees, with cars already parked there.
reasons: Other vehicles and a trailer already parked there
Backs onto open oval and tree line, no houses close
Flat, sealed, plenty of room to turn

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by sports oval, tennis courts and trees; clubhouse is 82 m away and non-residential, so nobody overlooks it closely.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed loop road leads straight into the car park, no gate visible in either image; plenty of flat space to pull off and turn.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end sports-field access road, not a through route; unlikely to see night traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars, a trailer and what looks like a small caravan are already parked here in the QLD image, so a van fits the pattern.

sun_shade: Open to the oval on the north and east; a treeline along the south and west edges of the car park gives afternoon shade.
cannot_judge: Whether the access road or car park gate is locked outside club hours
Ground surface firmness (gravel vs compacted dirt) for a 2WD van
Street or security lighting at night
